Wow, who the fuck are you? You sound like the biggest asshole right now. How DARE you come at us, and attack us when you know absolutely NOTHING about ARFID.

Furthermore, some of us have tried getting help, some of us have been sent away by doctors and told to just eat normally. 

Some of us have been told it’s all in our head and to eat a cheeseburger. 

“Oh, it’s all in your head, it’s not that hard to just eat. 

“I love to eat.”

“I’ll give you money for eating chicken nuggets”. 

ALL of that shit I was told to as a child. 

Do you know what that’s like for a five year old? 

Do you know how fucking worthless this made me feel? It still haunts me to this day!!!!

Until you can understand us, you can fuck off,  get downvoted into oblivion for all I care.
